subject: Game Theory
title: A Brief History of Auctions
description: A short lesson to help you apply A Brief History of Auctions.

hook.text: The earliest known auction dates to 500 BC Babylon, where women were sold as brides to the highest bidder.

buildup.text: Romans auctioned plunder from conquered lands. In 193 AD, the entire Roman Empire was auctioned off.

discovery.text: Christie's and Sotheby's, founded in the 1700s, turned art auctions into glamorous spectacles.

twist.text: The internet democratized auctions. eBay let anyone sell anything to anyone, anywhere, anytime.

climax.text: Today's biggest auctions are invisible: algorithms bid on ads billions of times per second.

punchline.text: Auctions evolved from shouts to clicks.

quiz.question: What was famously auctioned off in 193 AD?
